description: This Java source file defines the ProcessSnapshot class, which models a snapshot of a process for bug reporting purposes. It includes process metadata and a list of ThreadSnapshot objects, with methods for copying, comparison, and thread retrieval.

classes.name: ProcessSnapshot
classes.description: Class representing a snapshot of a process, including its PID, command line, date, and associated threads.

methods.name: ProcessSnapshot
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty ProcessSnapshot.

methods.name: ProcessSnapshot
methods.description: Copy constructor for creating a deep copy of an existing ProcessSnapshot.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the ProcessSnapshot instance.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ProcessSnapshot to another based on the process ID (pid).

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves the first ThreadSnapshot with a matching name.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves the first ThreadSnapshot with a matching thread ID (tid).

methods.name: getSysThread
methods.description: Retrieves the first ThreadSnapshot with a matching system thread ID (sysTid).
